definitions.name: One shift per day
definitions.description: Each employee can work at most one shift per day.

definitions.name: Manager coverage
definitions.description: Every shift requires at least 1 employee with manager skill.

definitions.name: Beverage coverage
definitions.description: Every shift requires at least 2 beverage-skilled employees.

definitions.name: Cashier coverage
definitions.description: Every shift requires at least 1 cashier-skilled employee.

definitions.name: Minimum staffing
definitions.description: Weekday shifts require 4 staff; weekend shifts require 6 staff.

definitions.name: Weekly work limit
definitions.description: An employee can work at most 5 shifts each week.

definitions.name: Consecutive-day limit
definitions.description: An employee can work at most 5 consecutive days, including the prior-week boundary.

definitions.name: Evening-to-morning rest
definitions.description: An evening shift cannot be followed by a morning shift, including across weeks.

definitions.name: Availability and leave
definitions.description: Assignments must respect availability, leave, and requested temporary changes.

definitions.name: Verified skills
definitions.description: Coverage skills come only from employee master data.

definitions.name: Workload balance
definitions.description: Penalize the maximum workload gap by -2 per shift.

definitions.name: Minimal replan changes
definitions.description: During replanning, penalize each changed assignment by -8.
